subject: As in the start frame: the strap stays on the front of the knee every frame.

camera.movement: Virtual camera already pushing in very slowly on frame one, no orbit, mechanically smooth. Still moving at the cut.

motion: Already cycling on frame one at walking cadence, one small arrival per second: the femur presses down onto the tibia a few degrees and eases, and on each arrival the rigid shell settles a fraction deeper into the tissue while the black knit band stretches along the line of force and eases back. Beneath the shell the patellar tendon barely moves and stays cool and pale the whole clip. The product holds station every frame. One single leg in frame, every bone keeping the exact shape and position it has in the start frame; the camera sees the same bones in every frame. Still cycling at the cut.
